title: Raw pullback commutes with higher-image comparison and restriction
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, W and S schemes, k:W→S, G a sheaf of Λ-modules on W_et, q an integer, A and B schemes over W, f:A→B over W, and U→S an etale object [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Set G_B=B^*G and G_A=A^*G. Let P_B(U)=Hom((B→S)^*Λ[U][0],G_B[q]), and likewise P_A, in the bounded-below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Define r_f:P_B(U)→P_A(U) explicitly by pullback composition, the single-complex comparison, derived pullback of the class, the shift comparison, and the shifted inverse-image composition identification f^*G_B≅G_A. Let e_A and e_B be the fixed canonical maps higherDirectImagePresheafToSheaf from these raw classes to higher-image sections. For every z∈P_B(U), e_A(r_f(z))=t_f(e_B(z)), where t_f is the canonical transition [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions]. For every etale arrow a:T→U, r_f(z|_T)=r_f(z)|_T. No limit, affine, or qcqs hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply the raw triangle comparison before evaluation to K=(B*G)[0], K′=(A*G)[0], and the canonical single-complex coefficient identification. Evaluate the resulting morphisms from the free sheaf at its identity generator. Naturality of freeSheafHomEquiv with respect to postcomposition gives the section equation. Expand higherDirectImageOverMap and functoriality of homology to identify its morphism with the displayed transition.
Apply naturality of raw triangle pullback under restriction with the same coefficient identification.

theorem higherDirectImageRawOverPullback_toSheaf
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ)
    {A B : Over W} (f : A ⟶ B) (U : S.Etale)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q B).obj (op U)) :
    (higherDirectImageRawOverComparison Λ k G q A).app (op U)
        (higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U z) =
    ((higherDirectImageOverMap Λ k G q f).hom.app (op U))
      ((higherDirectImageRawOverComparison Λ k G q B).app (op U) z) ∧
    ∀ (T : S.Etale) (a : T ⟶ U),
      higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f T
        ((higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q B).map a.op z) =
      (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q A).map a.op
            (higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U z)
